structured_output.what_is_happening: A non-pump.fun 'Super Intelligence' (SI) token, deployed directly to a PumpSwap pool 36 minutes before detection, riding a claimed Trump statement renaming AI to 'Super Intelligence'. It shows $3.9M hourly volume on ~$109k mcap (26x turnover), +127% in the hour, and ~$150k of pool liquidity, more than the market cap itself. The pool liquidity is 0% locked/burned. About 1,958 unique buyers compare with only 56 unique sellers who executed ~2,580 sells, a pattern consistent with a few bot/dev wallets selling supply into retail flow. GMGN flags 49 bundler wallets holding ~23%. Several same-name SI clones launched within the past ~2 hours on the same pattern, and at least two (12WKrr…, 68UV…) already show ~zero liquidity.

narrative.description: Political/AI meme: 'Trump renamed AI to Super Intelligence'. A timely headline-driven meme that spawned many SI clones in the last few hours.
narrative.why_spreading: A headline-style Trump + AI hook is easy to meme, and the burst of clones in the last ~6 hours shows traders chasing the story. But the attention is split across ~10 same-ticker tokens, and this one has no socials of its own.

token_connection.why_this_token: Only the name and ticker. No website, no project X/Telegram. The GeckoTerminal 'twitter' field is a link to a single tweet by gum_xbt, an account previously named solgummies, not a project account. The token is not a pump.fun launch.
token_connection.competing_tokens: At least 9 other SI tokens. 82ezhR…pump (pump.fun, $554k mcap, created ~5.4h earlier) looks most like a canonical community coin. ESwAE… ($6.7M h1 vol, $205k liq on $123k mcap) is the same liq>mcap direct-pool template. 12WKrr… ($1.9M h1 vol, $0 liq) and 68UV… ($57 liq) appear already rugged. 9LUf…pump is at $378k.

authenticity.evidence: Liquidity ($150k) is larger than mcap ($109k) on a direct PumpSwap deploy, and the LP is unlocked. 56 unique sellers made ~2,580 sells against ~1,958 buyers, which suggests a few bot sellers distributing into buyers. 49 bundler wallets hold 23%. Turnover is 26x per hour. Sister clones with the identical structure show zero liquidity within ~75 minutes of launch. There are no smart or renowned wallets and no promotion flags.
authenticity.uncertainty: The buyer count (~1,958 unique) suggests some real retail demand for the headline. The 56 sellers could partly be market-making bots rather than the dev. The creator's own wallet is nearly empty, so control of the LP position isn't directly shown in the packet.

structural_risks: Pool LP is 0% locked/burned, so it can be removed at any time
Few LP providers, likely a single dev-seeded position
Liquidity exceeds mcap, a known seeded-pool rug template
Same-template clones already drained to ~$0 liquidity
Heavy ticker fragmentation across ~10 SI tokens
Recycled X account (solgummies → gum_xbt) linked as the social

structured_output.counterargument: The headline is live and drawing a lot of real buyers (~2,000 unique in 36 minutes, buys outpacing sells ~1.8:1, still +4.6% over the last 5 minutes). Top-10 holders excluding the pool hold only ~17%, the creator holds almost nothing, mint and freeze are renounced, and no insider networks are flagged. If the LP holder leaves the pool in place and the Trump meme keeps spreading, the deep liquidity could support a move from ~$110k to $220k+ within hours. The fastest-volume clone on a hot headline sometimes becomes the one traders settle on.
unknowns: Who controls the LP position and whether they have pulled liquidity on earlier clones
Whether the Trump 'Super Intelligence' statement is real and how big the story is
Whether 12WKrr… and 68UV… share a deployer or funder with this token
The identity of the 56 seller wallets
Whether traders will settle on one SI coin, and which

source_coverage.notes: No internet access in this condition; judged only from the evidence packet.

structured_output.thesis: A seeded, unlocked-LP clone in a crowded SI ticker war. Its structure matches sister tokens that already rugged within about an hour. The seller concentration (56 wallets doing ~2,580 sells) points to a distribution operation, not an organic runner. Likely outcome: liquidity is pulled or the coin bleeds out before a 2x from a 25-minute-delayed entry.
